create_Coordinator: create a Coordinator instance to manage coordinated stop signals across multiple threads
use_stop_on_exception: use the stop_on_exception context manager to halt all threads when an exception occurs
run_coordinated_get: run coordinated_get to safely retrieve items from a shared queue while respecting stop signals
run_coordinated_put: run coordinated_put to safely add elements to a shared queue while respecting stop signals
use_request_stop: use request_stop to signal all coordinated threads to halt their current operations
